correctness.rationale: The Parseval-to-projection equivalence is exact. The absolute-value objective is exactly the maximum trace pairing with a Seidel sign matrix. Ky Fan reduces each fixed sign matrix to its two largest eigenvalues. Switching normal form exhausts all order-four Seidel matrices, and the characteristic-polynomial calculation gives the sharp value \(1+\sqrt5\). The spectral gap forces the equality projector uniquely, yielding the stated Gram classification. Exact replay checks verify the displayed projector and frame identities.
